00400 void ScopeGUI::calculateBuffers()
00401 {   
00402     if(tryLock() == true)
00403     {
00404         const int audioBufferSize = audioBuffer.size();
00405         const int drawBufferSize = getDisplayBufferSize();
00406         
00407         if(audioBufferSize > 0 && minDrawBuffer.size() > 0 && maxDrawBuffer.size() > 0)
00408         {
00409             minDrawBuffer.clear();
00410             maxDrawBuffer.clear();
00411             
00412             const double drawIndexInc = min(1.0, (double)drawBufferSize / (double)audioBufferSize);
00413             const double audioIndexInc = min(1.0, (double)audioBufferSize / (double)drawBufferSize);
00414             
00415             for(int channel = 0; channel < audioBuffer.getNumChannels(); channel++)
00416             {       
00417                 if(drawIndexInc < 1.0)
00418                 {
00419                     double drawIndex = 0.0;         
00420                     int previousDrawIndex = -1;
00421                     float minimum, maximum;
00422                     
00423                     for(int sample = 0; sample < audioBufferSize; sample++, drawIndex += drawIndexInc)
00424                     {
00425                         const int iDrawIndex = (int)drawIndex;
00426                         float value = audioBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, sample);
00427                         if(previousDrawIndex != iDrawIndex)
00428                         {
00429                             if(previousDrawIndex >= 0)
00430                             {
00431                                 minDrawBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, previousDrawIndex, minimum);
00432                                 maxDrawBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, previousDrawIndex, maximum);
00433                             }
00434                             
00435                             minimum = maximum = value;
00436                             previousDrawIndex = iDrawIndex;
00437                         }
00438                         else
00439                         {
00440                             minimum = min(minimum, value);
00441                             maximum = max(maximum, value);
00442                         }
00443                     }
00444                 }
00445                 else
00446                 {
00447                     double audioIndex = 0.0;
00448                     
00449                     for(int horiz = 0; horiz < drawBufferSize; horiz++, audioIndex += audioIndexInc)
00450                     {
00451                         float value = audioBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, (int)audioIndex);
00452                         minDrawBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, horiz, value);
00453                         maxDrawBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, horiz, value);
00454                     }
00455                 }
00456                 
00457             }
00458         }
00459         
00460         unlock();
00461     }
00462 }

00488 void ScopeUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00489 {
00490     if(scopeGUIref != 0)
00491     {
00492         // only works if ScopeGUI is the first in the in list of base classes!
00493         ScopeGUI *scopeGUI = *( static_cast<ScopeGUI**> (scopeGUIref) ); 
00494                 
00495         if(scopeGUI && scopeGUI->isValid())
00496         {
00497             float duration = *(inputs[Duration].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0));
00498             ugen_assert(duration > 0.f);
00499             
00500             int audioBufferSizeRequired = max(1, (int)(duration * UGen::getSampleRate() + 0.5));
00501             int audioBufferAllocatedSize = audioBuffer.size();            
00502             
00503             if(audioBufferSizeRequired > audioBufferAllocatedSize)
00504             {
00505                 if((audioBufferAllocatedSize > 1) && (bufferIndex >= audioBufferAllocatedSize))
00506                 {
00507                     scopeGUI->setAudioBuffer(audioBuffer.getRegion(0, audioBufferAllocatedSize-1), 
00508                                              samplesProcessed);
00509                     //samplesProcessed += audioBufferAllocatedSize;
00510                 }
00511                 
00512                 audioBuffer = Buffer(audioBufferSizeRequired, inputs[Input].getNumChannels(), false);
00513                 audioBufferSizeUsed = audioBufferSizeRequired;
00514                 bufferIndex = 0;
00515             }
00516             else if(audioBufferSizeRequired < audioBufferAllocatedSize)
00517             {
00518                 audioBufferSizeUsed = audioBufferSizeRequired;
00519                 
00520                 if(bufferIndex >= audioBufferSizeUsed)
00521                 {
00522                     scopeGUI->setAudioBuffer(audioBuffer.getRegion(0, audioBufferSizeUsed-1),
00523                                              samplesProcessed);
00524                     //samplesProcessed += audioBufferSizeUsed;
00525                     bufferIndex = 0;
00526                 }
00527             }
00528             
00529             int channelBufferIndex;
00530             
00531             for(int channel = 0; channel < audioBuffer.getNumChannels(); channel++)
00532             {
00533                 int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00534                 float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00535                 float* bufferSamples = audioBuffer.getData(channel);
00536                 channelBufferIndex = bufferIndex; // need a copy of this so it's the same at the start of processing each channel
00537                 
00538                 int bufferSamplesToProcess = audioBufferSizeUsed - channelBufferIndex;
00539                 
00540                 if(bufferSamplesToProcess > numSamplesToProcess)
00541                 {               
00542                     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00543                         bufferSamples[channelBufferIndex++] = *inputSamples++;
00544                 }
00545                 else
00546                 {
00547                     while(bufferSamplesToProcess--)
00548                         bufferSamples[channelBufferIndex++] = *inputSamples++;
00549                     
00550                     channelBufferIndex = 0;
00551                 }
00552             }
00553             
00554             bufferIndex = channelBufferIndex; // store for next block
00555             
00556             if(bufferIndex == 0)
00557             {
00558                 scopeGUI->setAudioBuffer(audioBuffer.getRegion(0, audioBufferSizeUsed-1),
00559                                          samplesProcessed);
00560                 //samplesProcessed += audioBufferSizeUsed;
00561             }
00562         }
00563     }
00564     
00565     samplesProcessed += uGenOutput.getBlockSize(); // make sure we increment the sample counter for EVERY block! even if we skip "frames"
00566 }

00574 BufferSenderUGenInternal::BufferSenderUGenInternal(UGen const& input, UGen const& duration) throw()
00575 :   UGenInternal(NumInputs),
00576     audioBuffer(BufferSpec((int)(UGen::getSampleRate()), input.getNumChannels(), true)),
00577     bufferIndex(0),
00578     audioBufferSizeUsed(0),
00579     samplesProcessed(0)
00580 {   
00581     inputs[Input] = input;

00583     
00584     audioBufferSizeUsed = max(1, (int)(duration.getValue() * UGen::getSampleRate() + 0.5));

00587 void BufferSenderUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00588 {
00589     float duration = *(inputs[Duration].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0));
00590     ugen_assert(duration > 0.f);
00591     
00592     int audioBufferSizeRequired = max(1, (int)(duration * UGen::getSampleRate() + 0.5));
00593     int audioBufferAllocatedSize = audioBuffer.size();            
00594     
00595     if(audioBufferSizeRequired > audioBufferAllocatedSize)
00596     {
00597         if((audioBufferAllocatedSize > 1) && (bufferIndex >= audioBufferAllocatedSize))
00598         {
00599             sendBuffer(audioBuffer.getRegion(0, audioBufferAllocatedSize-1), samplesProcessed);
00600         }
00601         
00602         audioBuffer = Buffer(audioBufferSizeRequired, inputs[Input].getNumChannels(), false);
00603         audioBufferSizeUsed = audioBufferSizeRequired;
00604         bufferIndex = 0;
00605     }
00606     else if(audioBufferSizeRequired < audioBufferAllocatedSize)
00607     {
00608         audioBufferSizeUsed = audioBufferSizeRequired;
00609         
00610         if(bufferIndex >= audioBufferSizeUsed)
00611         {
00612             sendBuffer(audioBuffer.getRegion(0, audioBufferSizeUsed-1), samplesProcessed);
00613             bufferIndex = 0;
00614         }
00615     }
00616     
00617     int numSamplesRemaining = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00618     int offset = 0;
00619     
00620     while(numSamplesRemaining > 0)
00621     {
00622         const int bufferSamplesToProcess = audioBufferSizeUsed - bufferIndex;
00623         const int numSamplesThisTime = min(bufferSamplesToProcess, numSamplesRemaining);
00624         
00625         for(int channel = 0; channel < audioBuffer.getNumChannels(); channel++)
00626         {
00627             int numSamplesToProcess = numSamplesThisTime;
00628             const float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel) + offset;
00629             float* bufferSamples = audioBuffer.getData(channel) + bufferIndex;
00630                     
00631             while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00632                 *bufferSamples++ = *inputSamples++;
00633         }
00634         
00635         numSamplesRemaining -= numSamplesThisTime;
00636         bufferIndex += numSamplesThisTime;
00637         samplesProcessed += numSamplesThisTime;
00638         offset += numSamplesThisTime;
00639         
00640         if(bufferIndex >= audioBufferSizeUsed)
00641         {
00642             sendBuffer(audioBuffer.getRegion(0, audioBufferSizeUsed-1), samplesProcessed);
00643             bufferIndex = 0;
00644         }   
00645     }   
00646 }

00682 void SpectralScopeUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00683 {
00684     if(scopeGUIref == 0) return;
00685     
00686     // only works if ScopeGUI is the first in the in list of base classes!
00687     ScopeGUI *scopeGUI = *( static_cast<ScopeGUI**> (scopeGUIref) ); 
00688     
00689     if(scopeGUI && scopeGUI->isValid())
00690     {
00691         int channelBufferIndex;
00692         
00693         // keep filling the buffer until it has enough samples...
00694         for(int channel = 0; channel < inputBuffer.getNumChannels(); channel++)
00695         {
00696             int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00697             float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00698             float* bufferSamples = inputBuffer.getData(channel);
00699             channelBufferIndex = bufferIndex; // need a copy of this so it's the same at the start of processing each channel
00700             
00701             int bufferSamplesToProcess = fftSize - channelBufferIndex;
00702             
00703             if(bufferSamplesToProcess > numSamplesToProcess)
00704             {               
00705                 while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00706                     bufferSamples[channelBufferIndex++] = *inputSamples++;
00707             }
00708             else
00709             {
00710                 while(bufferSamplesToProcess--)
00711                     bufferSamples[channelBufferIndex++] = *inputSamples++;
00712                 
00713                 channelBufferIndex = 0;
00714             }
00715         }
00716         
00717         bufferIndex = channelBufferIndex; // store for next block
00718         
00719         // was the buffer filled ?
00720         if(bufferIndex == 0)
00721         {
00722             // do fft and send
00723             for(int channel = 0; channel < inputBuffer.getNumChannels(); channel++)
00724             {               
00725                 fftEngine.fft(outputBuffer, inputBuffer, true, channel, channel);
00726             }
00727                         
00728             switch(mode_)
00729             {
00730                 case FFTEngine::RealImagRaw:
00731                     scopeGUI->setAudioBuffer(outputBuffer, 
00732                                              0, 
00733                                              fftSize);
00734                     break;
00735                 case FFTEngine::RealImagRawSplit:
00736                     scopeGUI->setAudioBuffer(fftEngine.rawToRealImagRawSplit(outputBuffer),
00737                                              0,
00738                                              fftSize);
00739                     break;
00740                 case FFTEngine::RealImagUnpacked:
00741                     scopeGUI->setAudioBuffer(fftEngine.rawToRealImagUnpacked(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00742                                              firstBin_,
00743                                              fftSize);
00744                     break;
00745                 case FFTEngine::RealImagUnpackedSplit:
00746                     scopeGUI->setAudioBuffer(fftEngine.rawToRealImagUnpackedSplit(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00747                                              firstBin_,
00748                                              fftSize);
00749                     break;
00750                 case FFTEngine::MagnitudePhase:
00751                     scopeGUI->setAudioBuffer(fftEngine.rawToMagnitudePhase(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00752                                              firstBin_,
00753                                              fftSize);
00754                     break;
00755                 case FFTEngine::MagnitudePhaseSplit:
00756                     scopeGUI->setAudioBuffer(fftEngine.rawToMagnitudePhaseSplit(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00757                                              firstBin_,
00758                                              fftSize);
00759                     break;                  
00760                 case FFTEngine::Magnitude: 
00761                     scopeGUI->setAudioBuffer(fftEngine.rawToMagnitude(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00762                                              firstBin_,
00763                                              fftSize);
00764                     break;
00765                 case FFTEngine::Phase: 
00766                     scopeGUI->setAudioBuffer(fftEngine.rawToPhase(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00767                                              firstBin_,
00768                                              fftSize);
00769                     break;
00770                 default:
00771                     scopeGUI->setAudioBuffer(fftEngine.rawToMagnitude(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00772                                              firstBin_,
00773                                              fftSize);
00774             }
00775             
00776             // keep overlapping samples for next FFT
00777             if((overlap_ > 1) && (uGenOutput.getBlockSize() < fftSize))
00778             {
00779                 const int hopSize = fftSize / overlap_;
00780                 const int copySize = fftSize - hopSize;
00781                 
00782                 for(int channel = 0; channel < inputBuffer.getNumChannels(); channel++)
00783                 {
00784                     float *bufferSamples = inputBuffer.getData(channel);
00785                     memcpy(bufferSamples, bufferSamples + hopSize, copySize * sizeof(float));
00786                 }
00787                 
00788                 bufferIndex = copySize;
00789             }
00790         }
00791     }
00792 }

00832 void FFTSenderUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00833 {
00834     int channelBufferIndex;
00835 
00836     // keep filling the buffer until it has enough samples...
00837     for(int channel = 0; channel < inputBuffer.getNumChannels(); channel++)
00838     {
00839         int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00840         float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00841         float* bufferSamples = inputBuffer.getData(channel);
00842         channelBufferIndex = bufferIndex; // need a copy of this so it's the same at the start of processing each channel
00843         
00844         int bufferSamplesToProcess = fftSize - channelBufferIndex;
00845         
00846         if(bufferSamplesToProcess > numSamplesToProcess)
00847         {               
00848             while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00849                 bufferSamples[channelBufferIndex++] = *inputSamples++;
00850         }
00851         else
00852         {
00853             while(bufferSamplesToProcess--)
00854                 bufferSamples[channelBufferIndex++] = *inputSamples++;
00855             
00856             channelBufferIndex = 0;
00857         }
00858     }
00859 
00860     bufferIndex = channelBufferIndex; // store for next block
00861 
00862     // was the buffer filled ?
00863     if(bufferIndex == 0)
00864     {
00865         // do fft and send
00866         for(int channel = 0; channel < inputBuffer.getNumChannels(); channel++)
00867         {               
00868             fftEngine.fft(outputBuffer, inputBuffer, true, channel, channel);
00869         }
00870         
00871         switch(mode_)
00872         {
00873             case FFTEngine::RealImagRaw:
00874                 sendBuffer(outputBuffer, 0, fftSize);
00875                 break;
00876             case FFTEngine::RealImagRawSplit:
00877                 sendBuffer(fftEngine.rawToRealImagRawSplit(outputBuffer),
00878                            0, fftSize);
00879                 break;
00880             case FFTEngine::RealImagUnpacked:
00881                 sendBuffer(fftEngine.rawToRealImagUnpacked(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00882                            firstBin_, fftSize);
00883                 break;
00884             case FFTEngine::RealImagUnpackedSplit:
00885                 sendBuffer(fftEngine.rawToRealImagUnpackedSplit(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00886                            firstBin_, fftSize);
00887                 break;
00888             case FFTEngine::MagnitudePhase:
00889                 sendBuffer(fftEngine.rawToMagnitudePhase(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00890                            firstBin_, fftSize);
00891                 break;
00892             case FFTEngine::MagnitudePhaseSplit:
00893                 sendBuffer(fftEngine.rawToMagnitudePhaseSplit(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00894                            firstBin_, fftSize);
00895                 break;                  
00896             case FFTEngine::Magnitude: 
00897                 sendBuffer(fftEngine.rawToMagnitude(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00898                            firstBin_, fftSize);
00899                 break;
00900             case FFTEngine::Phase: 
00901                 sendBuffer(fftEngine.rawToPhase(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00902                            firstBin_, fftSize);
00903                 break;
00904             default:
00905                 sendBuffer(fftEngine.rawToMagnitude(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_),
00906                            firstBin_, fftSize);
00907         }
00908         
00909         // keep overlapping samples for next FFT
00910         if((overlap_ > 1) && (uGenOutput.getBlockSize() < fftSize))
00911         {
00912             const int hopSize = fftSize / overlap_;
00913             const int copySize = fftSize - hopSize;
00914             
00915             for(int channel = 0; channel < inputBuffer.getNumChannels(); channel++)
00916             {

00918                 memcpy(bufferSamples, bufferSamples + hopSize, copySize * sizeof(float));
00919             }
00920

00922         }
00923     }
